en: Hmph, that's none of your business.
Will you fight this time? Or run away again?
I can't let you get in the way of my last bit of fun.
No, I came to defeat you and the Heavenly Dragon, and bring peace back to the world.
There's no need to listen to a devil's words any longer.
Leyla!!!
...This light...?
Such a cruel thing...
Bad People
Hey, that's enough.
What? Kid.
Stop tormenting people who can't fight back!
Feisty, ain't you, little master.
But... I don't take orders from a kid. You want to get hurt?!
Tch, if words won't get through to you, I'll stop you by force.
Funny brat. Get him.
Bad People (After Battle)
Old Man
Well? See who's stronger now? Take me to your employer.
Tch... fine.
So you're the one who's been gathering thugs and tormenting the people around here.
W-who are you?
I've beaten every one of your soldiers to a pulp.
That crest on your chest is the mark of the royal family...
Never mind who I am! Leave this land right now.
Or else... the king won't forgive you either.
...F-forgive me. Please, have mercy.
An apology won't cut it. Leave everything you own and get out. And never come back.
Y-yes, understood. R-right away!
Rudi's Country Soldier 1
Rudi's Country Soldier 2
Rudi's Country Soldier 3
Rudi's Country Soldier 4
Guard
You brat, what do you think you're doing?! I'll teach you what you've done, so brace yourself!
Let go of me!
Hey, stop it. He's just a kid. What did he even do?
He threw a stone at the carriage of the great noble Souza-sama.
Did that stone hurt anybody?
It only scratched the carriage, but we can't allow anything to happen.
Rude riffraff like this must be punished, as an example to others.
For that? That's going too far. Let him go.
You've no right to give me orders. Stay out of this.
...Can't be helped. Guard, look at this crest.
Hm? That's the mark of the royal family...
I'm an envoy of the royal family. On my authority, I'll take charge of that child.
...I can't defy the crest. Very well. I'll let the child go.
Listen, boy, do the same thing again and you're dead. Remember that.
Tch...
You all right?
Town Girl
Leoni! Are you okay?
Thank you for helping us...
Nah, it was nothing.
Leoni, Mom's over there worrying about you. Let's go home.
Leoni
Come on, say thank you!
...Thanks.
Royal envoy, I'd like to put this boy's parents at ease. May we go?
Yeah, sure. Take care.
Thank you so much.
Reunion (First)
Hello.
Um, you're...
Thanks for the other day. You're very brave, aren't you?
...Nah, not really.
Those guys were doing something that stupid to a kid, so...
What's your name?
Rudi... Rudi Trier.
I'm Savia. Are you a noble?
Sort of... not a very important one. ...I do stuff like being a special envoy for the royal family.
Huh, so there are decent people among the western nobles too.
The only nobles we poor easterners ever meet are arrogant types like those.
Well, there are all kinds of people...
What do you do?
I look after poor children and teach them to read and write.
Drop by next time you're around here. Tell me about your travels.
If you ask the children, I'm sure they'll tell you where I am.
Oh, yeah. I'll drop by.
See you, then. Thank you.
Reunion
Rudi! You came?
Oh, yeah, I happened to be nearby, so.
Will you tell me about your travels? I'm sure the children will love it too.
Sure, no problem.
Then, this way.
I'm sorry for keeping you so late.
Not at all. I'm traveling alone anyway. It was fun.
Thank you, Rudi. The children were so happy.
If stories like mine are good enough, I've got plenty.
Rudi, come again. I'll be waiting.
Yeah, I'll come again for sure.
Armored Man
Militia/Rebel
Hey, are you the ones causing trouble around here?
And what if we are?
I won't let you pull this kind of thing while I'm around.
Cheeky brat!
That all? Not so tough!
You... you mean to get in our way...
Another one, huh... Pretty hulking guy. I'll take you all on at once.
...I'll crush you...
Secret Meeting
Savia, what are you doing here?
I'm sorry. This is so sudden.
No, thanks for back then. You saved me...
I was looking for you, you know. I wanted to thank you...
...Rudi, I need your help with that.
Ever since then, I've been chased by the armored men who captured you...
I've been running all this time, but I have nowhere left to go...
I see... it's my fault...
...I know, I've got a good idea. Run west.
To the royal palace. Believe it or not, I've got a fair bit of pull.
I'll write a letter right now. Take it and show it to anyone at the palace.
I'm sure they'll take you on. Those guys can't chase you all the way to the great palace in the west, right?
...Yes... but are you sure?
Yeah, it's fine. I'm the one you saved.
Now it's my turn.
Thank you, Rudi.
You're... the one from back then?
Yes. You got away safely. I'm glad.
I'm sorry I didn't tell you my name then. I'm Savia. And you?
I'm Rudi... Rudi Trier... Thanks so much for back then. You saved me.
I've been looking for you ever since. I wanted to thank you...
Um... I hate to ask this of you, but I need your help with that.
Huh? What happened?
I'm being chased by the armored men who captured you.
Why were you in that place...?
I used to come and go there. It's the hideout of the assassins who attacked you, and my little brother was one of them...
They gather poor people from the eastern lands and attack or threaten rich nobles.
That armored man is their leader...
I see... So are you one of them too?
No, I'm not...! But I can't blame you for suspecting me... Still, please believe me.
Because I let you escape, they treat me as a traitor now... And all I did was go to see my brother...
I can't run any longer...
Because of me... you ended up like this...
I know, I've got a good idea. Run west.
To the royal palace. Actually, I do stuff like being a special envoy for the royal family, so I've got a little pull.
Rudi, who on earth are you...
I'll explain later. First we have to keep you safe.
I'll write a letter right now. Take it and show it to anyone at the palace.
I'm sure they'll take you on.
Those guys can't chase you all the way to the great palace in the west, right?
But are you sure?
Now it's my turn to help you.
Well, take care.
Demons
W-what are these things...? Monsters... in the army?
Terror
Are you the assassins?
...You mean to interfere?
Yeah. I can't let people like you run wild. Not in this country.
Hmph, get him!
Savia...
Rudi... I have a favor to ask you...
Stop my brother...
Your brother? Yours?
...That armored man is my little brother, Savio...
The armor... the armor is eating away at Savio... I'm scared... you're the only one I can...
Tell me... everything.
...The two of us, sister and brother, were born in the slums of Cadiz. Around where I met you...
When we were little, we were sold to a noble, so there'd be fewer mouths to feed.
That noble gathered children and raised them as assassins. As his own tools...
And we grew up being told, over and over, that we were so poor our parents had to sell us because the eastern royals and nobles were lining their own pockets.
So we never questioned living as killers, taking part in that western noble's schemes.
We thought it was the right thing...
But one day, our employer set a trap for Savio and me, to kill us...
Whether he wanted to bury the secrets we knew, or thought we'd outlived our use... I don't know why.
The two of us were locked in a house, and it was set on fire...
Somehow we escaped the flames. But Savio shielded me and was badly hurt...
He was burned all over, barely breathing...
Then a sorceress appeared and gave my brother armor... she said it was magic armor...
Savio's life was saved.
But... he became like a wraith, living on rage and curses.
It got worse and worse, and now... no one can stop him...
That armor scares me... it's turning my brother into someone who isn't my brother...
